verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office and compliance SaaS platform, so user-configurable recurring workflows are a fair question for it. The evidence shows only a compliance dashboard listing upcoming deadlines and staff-handled tasks (one-off actions done for the user), not any user-defined recurring schedule. Probes also found no API or OpenAPI surface that could support scheduled jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
